question: Who among the following has been chosen as the male goalkeeper of the year by the International Hockey Federation (FIH) 2021-22?
solution:
__
 
• The correct answer is **PR Sreejesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Veteran Indian Hockey goalkeeper P R Sreejesh has won the prestigious World Games Athlete of the Year for his 2021 performances.
 
• He has become only the 2nd Indian to receive the accolade.
 
• In 2020, Indian Women’s hockey captain Rani Rampal became the first Indian to win the honor for her 2019 performance.
